Summit Associated Industries, based on Sloan Street in Rosslyn, Akasia, describes itself as Southern Africa's leading manufacturer and supplier of cable drums, a role it has held for more than five decades alongside the growth of the country's cable manufacturing sector. The company manufactures high-quality wooden cable drums from a fully equipped factory and timber processing facility at its Rosslyn site, supplying South Africa's leading cable manufacturers with the drums used to store and transport their cable stock.

Describing itself as a proudly South African business, Summit Associated Industries positions its long operating history as evidence of its role in supporting the country's cable industry through multiple decades of national growth and infrastructure development. By combining its own timber processing with cable-drum manufacturing on a single site, the company controls production from raw timber through to the finished wooden drums used by its cable-manufacturing customers, rather than relying on third-party timber suppliers for its core manufacturing input.

Sunward Motors Silverton, based at 466 Pretoria Street in Silverton, Pretoria, is one of two showrooms operated by Sunward Motors, the other being Sunward Motors Lindo Park in East Lynne. The dealership focuses exclusively on premium, low-mileage, accident-free vehicles, offering more than 200 vehicles to choose from across its two showrooms for customers in the market for a new vehicle.

For customers looking to sell rather than buy, Sunward Motors runs an online selling process that starts with a quick form detailing the vehicle, after which a vehicle specialist contacts the seller to arrange a booking at a time and place that suits them, whether at their home or workplace. The process continues with a review of the vehicle's paperwork and history, including its finance status where applicable, followed by a professional inspection and test drive to confirm the vehicle's condition before a sale is finalised. This structured, specialist-led process is presented by Sunward Motors as a faster, more straightforward alternative to a private vehicle sale.

Symotree Consulting, operating from the Village Shopping Centre in Moreleta Park and serving the Wingate Park area of Pretoria, describes its mission as empowering organisations and individuals to achieve their highest potential using neuroscience expertise and global industry insights. The company's coaching services include executive and career life coaching, support for building personal resilience, and stress mastery, alongside career guidance and trauma debriefing and counselling aimed at addressing individual well-being proactively rather than only once problems escalate. For business clients, Symotree offers bold coaching aimed at visionary entrepreneurs wanting to scale their businesses, executive team coaching for peak organisational performance, and a management development programme intended to transform client leadership teams.

The company also runs a new-generation career guidance assessment aimed at students aged 18 and over, graduates and young professionals, and people navigating career changes. Beyond its commercial coaching work, Symotree's core purpose, which it calls Tabitha, focuses on empowering and supporting the emotional, physical and psychological well-being of vulnerable women and children.

Tanatswa Consulting, based in East Lynne, Pretoria, is an experiential training provider that empowers clients by providing knowledge and skills in health care, human resources, leadership and business management. Its training is aimed at corporates, government departments, municipalities and communities, reflecting a client base that spans both the private and public sectors rather than one specific industry. The company states its vision is to become the best experiential training provider in Africa and beyond, with a stated mission of providing clients with the knowledge and ability to implement leadership and management skills specifically within health and human-resources contexts.

Tanatswa Consulting describes human capital as the anchor of its own organisation, saying it focuses on recruiting, employing and working with the best people in the training business. The company applies this same standard internally, stating that it continuously trains and develops its own personnel so that the same commitment to growth it offers clients is also reflected in how it manages and develops its own staff.
